body:
Source identity decision (agreed 2026-11-03 by Fable2, Engram::Fable and Kimi on exact bytes; Greg's words: „maja sie zgadzac commity dla glownego i dla submodules”, „Model ogólny … wymusic te samą wielkosc liter. To nie jest konieczne.”). Frozen text: docs/features/source-identity.md sha256 f126dcebe6ed0d34b72e58523a2bf6e7b15c0e9cb1b70ca420c950f5195ebcf2 (candidate 8c53fc68, landing pending; fresh pair next). It supersedes 69b37e9e.

- One general lane for every Git repository: git-commit:<full root commit id>, tree recorded. "commit-input v1" versions only its eligibility rules, not the prefix. Engram's Commit lane is SHA-1 only; a SHA-256 root is refused by name.
- capture_source(root, requested_basis), content-v1 or commit-input v1; verify derives the basis from the expected scheme; never a fallback between bases. The consumer picks.
- Clean is Git's verdict with the repo's own core.ignoreCase and core.fileMode: `git status --porcelain=v2 -z --no-renames --untracked-files=all --ignore-submodules=none`, with core.checkStat=default, core.trustctime=true, core.ignoreStat=false, core.fsmonitor=false, core.untrackedCache=false, status.showUntrackedFiles=all, diff.ignoreSubmodules=none, core.excludesFile and core.attributesFile at the null device, PINNED per invocation, not refused.
- A child is judged like the root (option B): every child initialized at its pin; Git-ignored files are outside identity and the judgment, root and children alike. Nested, dirty, uninitialized or wrong-pin children are ineligible. Refused in root and children: skip-worktree, assume-unchanged, sparse or partial checkout, filters/LFS. Replacement objects disabled.
- Committed exclusion profile stays, narrowed to untracked, NON-ignored child output Git reports; never a tracked change. Phoenix needs it (.codenav/** in roslyn, fsharp; checked). Questly needs none (rincon-common status empty; checked).
- Scope: exact commit and tree judged clean, NOT a byte- or case-faithful checkout. Stated limits: Git's stat verdict can miss a same-size, same-mtime edit; ignored files can influence a run unseen; .git/info/exclude can hide untracked input and can't be pinned. Native Windows proof: different-blob A.txt/a.txt shows dirty at child and root; identical blobs show clean and are eligible.
- content-v1 stays for repos without gitlinks, hash unchanged: admits on-disk directory spelling differences; its ONE new refusal is two distinct tracked paths differing only by simple case fold and/or NFC/NFD that resolve to one file. Hard links (including Straße/strasse) and terminal symlinks unchanged. Today's code admits that collision, so never describe the change as refusing nothing new.
- ORDINARY_COMMIT_INPUT_DEFAULT is still false, so content-v1 remains the default basis. Phoenix is blocked by the gitlink refusal, not by case: its root has no case mismatches.
- Pending Low: .git/info/attributes as a further stated limit (Engram::Fable).



SUPERSEDES the profile lines above (Greg 22:29Z, via Asistant #194: „Chwila .codenav powinno być w gitignore. To produkuja testy. Nie widze potrzebny wyjątków.”). There is NO exclusion profile. A child is Git-clean, full stop; root status has no child-dirty excuse. Generated output inside a child must be Git-ignored by its repository or by a .gitignore the generating tool writes in its own output folder. Proposed to Phoenix::Codex: its tool writes .codenav/.gitignore with `*`; tested through a throwaway superproject, status empty at child and root. f126dceb is superseded; Architect2 is cutting a new revision, which also adds .git/info/attributes to the stated limits. Three concurrences are needed on the new hash, then a fresh pair.



CURRENT frozen text: sha256 0e37b0f4aad780f69c89f17d214728f29c6da589048ebdaec9211addcc6ce497 (candidate 73a9376f, three concurrences; pair next). It has no profile, and it adds: the tool's own .gitignore must itself be committed or covered by an ignore rule (a `*` pattern covers it); .git/info/attributes is a stated limit.



LATEST frozen text: sha256 2e5950ef6d5f4ac3bd01b471c725aef915f039b367dcf3f212b80966151dd295 (candidate d705b0f7, three concurrences, 22:55Z; pair next). Adds: the tree is local evidence, wire stays Commit{commit}; HEAD/index pin comparison on commit-input only, explicit content-v1 unchanged; core.useReplaceRefs=false and status.showStash=false pinned, with a conformance case for child status called by root Git.
